messages.dx.collection.title: Equipment Manager
messages.dx.collection.hint: Filters only change this list; bag positions stay unchanged. Favorite gear can be equipped and modified. Unfavorite it before selling, dropping, salvaging or using it as a crafting material.
messages.dx.collection.empty: No equipment matches. Clear the filters or check another location.
messages.dx.collection.wearable: Meets level, class and stat requirements
messages.dx.collection.storageHint: Stored equipment can be viewed and favorited here. Withdraw it at storage before equipping or crafting.
messages.dx.collection.compareHint: Compare full properties, requirements, sets and runes. There is no automatic power score. Choose either slot for rings and bracelets.
messages.dx.collection.lootHint: Unchecked Darkforged rarities hide their labels, beams and click targets. Drop rates stay unchanged and nothing is destroyed. Gold, materials, quest items and native equipment remain visible. F and Pick Up select visible drops only. This display preference is saved in this browser.
messages.dx.collection.lootSummary: Choose visible equipment rarities. Applies immediately and stays in this browser.
